title: Pragmatic lean MVP for remaining orchestrator release work

tldr.content: The lean MVP is release-evidence closure: reconcile the parent plan to the pushed SHA, add one real csm-orchestrate-to-browse proof, require one composed Docker generated-provider proof, enable the existing CI gate only on a runner with Docker/browser prerequisites, and complete only when the adapter step executes and passes. Otherwise remain BLOCKED.

executiveSummary.content: Implementation and local verification are largely complete. Browser E2E passed 89/89, Docker generated execution passed its composed probe, and the full local suite passed 1,283 tests. CI run 33429777585 is green but its adapter integration step printed SKIP because both repository variables were unset. The parent plan and build state retain stale task claims. The safe MVP is one exact-SHA reconciliation, one real orchestrator adapter trace, one required CI run with no skip, and one honest terminal state.

keyFindings.content:
K1. supported: Most implementation and local verification work is complete; another generic adapter abstraction is not needed. [R1][R2]

K2. supported: A green default CI job can still skip required adapter integration. [R3][R4]

K3. partially-supported: Docker generated execution is locally composed and inspect-bound, but local evidence cannot replace exact-SHA CI evidence. [R2][R5]

K4. partially-supported: Raw browser E2E proves csm-browse lifecycle behavior, but a real orchestrator-to-browse trace is still needed for receipt and evidence translation. [R6][R7]

K5. supported: Parent plan/build state must be reconciled before completion; historical and quarantined artifacts must not be rewritten. [R1][R8]

detailSections.content:
### Lean execution path

1. Reconcile exact provenance to de4dfc5, recording the implementation commit 7638d41, CI run URL/SHA, current plan digest, and build-state digest. Correct only active parent records.

2. Add one real browse proof using real session provisioning, one typed operation through createCsmBrowseAdapter and createInProcessExecutorAdapter.invoke, resolver validation, native/translated evidence, receipt, cleanup, and redaction. Keep raw 89/89 E2E as a separate lifecycle gate.

3. Add one real generated proof through createGeneratedProvider.evaluate with Docker attestation, inspect-before/after, source/policy/image hashes, cleanup, and artifact lineage.

4. Enable one CI integration lane with CSM_ADAPTER_INTEGRATIONS=1 and CSM_ADAPTER_INTEGRATIONS_APPROVED=1, on a runner with Docker/browser prerequisites. Require make test-adapter-integrations-required and reject SKIPPED.

5. Run make audit && make check && make fmt-check && make lint && make test, obtain independent final review, and complete the parent state only when every required gate executed.

Do not restart historical adapter plans, execute quarantined application plans, or redesign csm-orchestrate. Docker documentation confirms namespaces, cgroups, mounts, capabilities, and daemon configuration are security boundaries, not automatic proof. [R5][R9]

recommendation.content: Recommend the lean MVP above: exact-SHA/state reconciliation, one real orchestrator-to-browse integration trace, one composed Docker generated-provider trace, and one required non-skipping CI run. This closes the actual gap without broad infrastructure. If the runner or authorized administrator cannot provide the required capabilities/variables, keep the parent release BLOCKED.

unverifiedClaims.content:
1. Parent plan/build records need exact-SHA reconciliation. [R1]
2. CI runner Docker/browser capability and repository-variable access remain unverified. [R3][R4]
3. Local Docker evidence does not cover daemon, kernel, or image vulnerabilities. [R5]
4. One live browse trace is the minimum proposed proof; broader release claims may require more operations. [R6][R7]
5. Branch protection and required-check settings were not observable without authenticated administration access. [R3]

processAppendix.content: Tier: DEEP. Source mode: hybrid. Four independent research tracks covered backlog, CI, Docker sandbox, and browser/orchestrator integration. Current GitHub and Docker documentation was retrieved directly. The anti-anchored challenger downgraded the first draft for missing evidence and the judge scored factual accuracy 0.88, citation accuracy 0.82, completeness 0.68, clarity 0.90. Remediation added exact-SHA provenance, live adapter proof, mandatory generated composition, runner prerequisites, variable authorization, and parent reconciliation. No implementation was performed by this research run.
